steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: This is great, Rise. Thank you for providing Bagel's email. She clicked the fake link, and now we have full account access. The operation can continue now.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Speaking of which, she really trusts you. After going through so much, you've finally made some good friends in your new workplace. Good for you.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...We're not from the same world. We're not friends.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: In any case, it's all for the mission. Are you sure this will help Chief?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Of course. Next, you need to hide well. Isn't that development team desperately looking for the mole? Be careful not to get exposed.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: We still need a bit more time before the real counterattack.
She reviews the operation progress with interest, thinking how much better it would be if Chief could hold out a bit longer.
